key_claims: The US goal was withdrawal of Soviet troops from Afghanistan, or at least making Soviet involvement as costly as possible.
The US decided to resume and facilitate military sales to Pakistan and to ask Saudi Arabia to help finance Pakistan's purchases.
The US would provide two GEARING-class destroyers, $40 million PL-480 aid and refugee assistance to Pakistan.
The US would urge Pakistan to set aside the nuclear issue while dealing with the Soviet-Afghan problem.
The US would not link the Soviet action in Afghanistan to SALT.
